At some point in [[Time/Legends|history]], an '''unidentified traveling explorer''' visited the skies of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], a [[Tree/Legends|forested]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], in a [[hot air balloon]]. He or she crashed on top of the [[Explorer's Crag]], a steep peak located near Endor's [[Happy Grove/Legends|Happy Grove]]. The was trapped atop the Crag, and he or she ended up [[Death/Legends|dying]] in the balloon's gondola. The explorer's [[Skeleton/Legends|skeleton]] was rediscovered around [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], when the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] named [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] flew over the Explorer's Crag with his [[Hang-glider/Legends|skin glider]].<ref name="TB" />
